title: The article discusses the significant impact of the African Nations Cup on English football, particularly the Premier League. Key players like Michael Essien and Didier Drogba, who play for Chelsea, and Kolo Toure from Arsenal, are highlighted for their contributions to their clubs and their national teams. The absence of these African stars during the tournament will affect their respective clubs, especially Arsenal and Chelsea, as they will miss out on crucial talent. The piece emphasizes that while the outcome of the Nations Cup may not concern the clubs, the availability of their players is critical for the ongoing season.
